body: Founder: 'all of that needs to be requirementized' after the mashup-discovery scoping thread surfaced real ambiguity (tuxedo duck vs tuxedo, tuxedo duck vs duck wearing a tuxedo vs duck tuxedo, president vs the president, Rapunzel content-policy drift over time). Wrote up as two docs: EMILY/docs/NORTHSTAR_PROMPT_O_VERSE.md §9 (mashup/hybrid discovery requirements -- why lexical matching fails, what a real solution needs, deferred per founder's own AskUserQuestion answer) and emily.cli/README.md 'Ontology' section (subject-identity requirements: compositional ambiguity, paraphrase equivalence and its limits, definite vs indefinite reference, stateless vs stateful execution, fixed points/zero points in time, styles/tags flagged as likely-same-issue but explicitly deferred). No code implements any of this -- S176-29 stays deferred, this is documentation of requirements only. EMILY 8bbae85, emily.cli c9cf55f+1460cee.
title: Requirementized mashup/hybrid discovery + ontology (deferred, docs only)
